identityResolution.rationale: The routed identity conflict is resolved by rejecting a current Washington, DC storefront claim. The restaurant-issued location directory and restaurant-linked ordering surface did not expose a Washington, DC location, while the restaurant-issued homepage, official menu, February 2026 allergen PDF, and February 2026 ingredient document establish a current Mendocino Farms chain-level catalog. The 112-product catalog may therefore be retained only as a bounded chain-level catalog and must not be represented as DC-location-specific.

menuScopeResolution.rationale: The exact unresolved frozen-item key set is empty: all 112 frozen keys are exact matches. The exact mergeBindingSolReview partial-surface set is also empty because no current surface is marked partial or unresolved. The restaurant-issued official menu and February 2026 documents define the bounded current chain-level food and nonalcoholic catalog. The unavailable linked-ordering surface is already noncurrent and contributes no evidence-supported DC-only products, so no product addition or surface mutation is supported.

authorityResolution.rationale: No source-authority conflict remains. Restaurant-issued sources control the chain identity, catalog, ingredients, and direct allergen positives. The restaurant-linked ordering surface is used only to establish that no Washington, DC-specific vendor menu was exposed, and the third-party targeted search does not override restaurant-issued evidence. Unavailable allergen fields are not claims of absence.
